title: Generalizing Fairness to Generative Language Models via Reformulation of Non-discrimination Criteria

bias_targets.methodology: Reformulating standard classification fairness criteria (independence, separation, and sufficiency) for generative AI. Methods include measuring gender pronoun/name associations in generated anecdotes about specific professions (independence), comparing error rates and predictive values in occupational and medical multiple-choice questions using forced pronoun coreference (separation and sufficiency), and analyzing differences in generated hobbies prompted by male versus female names.
